utterances.text: To the best of your knowledge, do you recall when that happened, when that bombing occurred, what month?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: I can't really recall. I think it was in 1999.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Could I have 65 ter 1468. I think that's the map. Okay. Great.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Do you have in front of you, Mr. Witness? Not yet.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Okay. It appears to me to be loaded. I wonder if we could zoom in on the -- yes, right about where you are now. Near Ka Avali, which is on the top right. Great. Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Can you see that, Mr. Witness?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Now, the area of Ka Avali, could you tell us where specifically that's located? Is that in Serbia?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: That's in Serbia, on the Cer mountain.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Now, you'd indicated that from that area the two lines proceeding downward and to the left you had previously designated 8 and 9 respectively from the left to the right. With respect to the line --

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: -- from that location to the left, that is farthest to the left, to which location does that line run?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: This line reads towards the Zvornik Brigade. That is to say, that line first goes to Gucevo radio relay hub, which is also in Serbia, and then further on to Zvornik, because there was no optical visibility between Zvornik and Cer.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: And the line moving to the left that is to the right of the line going to Zvornik, can you tell us where that line goes?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: According to our information, this line went directly to the TV tower on Mount Avala another Belgrade.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Okay. Can we zoom out. And could we go to the bottom. There we go. And zoom in right where the large hub is. That's pretty good.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Can you see that, Mr. Witness?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Microphone.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Okay. Can we zoom in a little bit more, and could you tell us what that triangle is at the centre of the screen?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: This triangle is a radio relay hub called Veliki Zep.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Could we blow that up just a little bit more? Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Okay. Now, there are a number of lines that are going to or from that particular location, and I'd like to focus your attention on those lines that are to the right of your screen, and if you could tell us where they go. But I'm going to have you mark this exhibit if you could.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Since this is a mountainous area of Bosnia, it was necessary to connect them in this manner, and this part of Bosnia was not included in the system. Well, this is why they used a radio relay system, especially radio relay 1, which was quite mobile, and could have been placed in any house, on any mountain, and so on. The thickest black line was the route leading to Cer. This was the link to Serbia and to the eastern part of Bosnia and Herzegovina, all the way down to Banja Luka. As for the lines below, those are the routes established via RRU 1. I don't see the right part of the map, but I think that that area leads to Bratunac Brigade. I think another one goes to Pribicevac, to Milicevo, and I don't see the rest of it. To the Skelani Brigade. Those were the subordinate units of the Drina Corps.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: With respect to the thick black line on the right of the screen going up from the triangle, could you mark on that line or next to that line the number 9.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: The pen cannot write. [Marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Thank you. And could you mark sequentially the lines I guess in a clockwise kind of way. Number them sequentially, that is 10, 11, et cetera, and could you tell us where they go, if you know.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: I've already said we can't see it on this map all the locations to which this leads. The first line is the radio relay route RR -- RRU 1 leading to the Bratunac Brigade below number 9. Then the second line leads to the Skelani Brigade.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Could you mark these lines as you go along.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: This is 10. This is 11. And the third line I think goes towards the forward command post, Pribicevac, which is above Srebrenica. No, I apologise. The second line leads to Pribicevac. Line 11 leads to Pribicevac. And line 12 that I'm marking right now leads towards the Skelani Brigade. Line 13 led towards the Rogatica Brigade. This thick black line is the link with the next radio relay hub which was located near Foca or Bileca. I believe it was called Zlovrh, but I'm not sure. The other lines lead toward subordinate units of the Drina Corps.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Could you, if you have a chance, just indicate next to the line the location to which it goes. For example, 9 you would write Cer. 10 to the extent that it goes to Bratunac, maybe you can write BRA or something of that nature so that we know exactly what you're talking about. Alternatively, I suppose we could pull back a little bit on the map, zoom out. It can't be done. Okay. All right. So that would probably be a better way to do it. Just write the first couple of letters of the location to which the line goes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Please use capital letters.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: You'd indicated that the thick black line goes to Cer; is that right?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: It says here on this map Veliki Tmor. I think that's the name of the radio relay hub.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: What I'm referring to is number 9, how you labelled it. Is that the line, the thick black line that you referenced earlier going to Cer?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: I apologise. I made a mistake. 9 leads towards Cer and 10 leads towards Bratunac. Can this be erased? Line 10 leads to Bratunac. It's fine now.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Now, there are certain other indications on the map. Can you tell us what the designation Panorama is in the centre of these vectors?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: The word Panorama was a code-name for the radio relay hub called Veliki Zep.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: And did the name have any other significance to you in terms of the functioning of your unit?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Well, these code-names were of key importance, because when the link was established radio operators would call the person under their secret code-name. For example, if they called Panorama, they asked for the name Gric, Vrelo, or they asked for Obala in Bijela. So those code-names existed in order to establish links, in order to physically switch the connection to make the link.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Can you tell us what Uran is? If you see that triangle on the right side of the exhibit.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Uran is the terminal radio relay station that appeared after the fall of Srebrenica. In our view, this station used the same equipment that existed at Pribicevac, which means that once Pribicevac was shut down, route 11 leading to Pribicevac, you can see it here, this other station appeared a day later, and it was established for the purpose of operation to seize Zepa.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Can he circle Uran, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Marks].

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: And while he was testifying before, he did give an indication what line 14 stands for, where does it lead. If he could put in the name of the corps or whatever he stated earlier on.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Line 14 led towards the second hub called Veliki Tmor. It was a route for the Hercegovina Corps. So from Veliki Tmor, the route led further down towards Bileca, towards the Hercegovina Corps.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: And you also testified on the line next to it which seems to indicate at the bottom, Pale, but you mentioned the Drina Corps. If you could then give it a number, number 15, please, and put down "Drina Corps."

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Marks]. Your Honours, this was not the link with the Drina Corps. It was the link with Pale. Since the political authorities were in Pale, the army reinforced this link with a 24-channel device called RRU 800.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Is that denominated by a 24 that is depicted or written at the bottom of this exhibit?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: And could you indicate further on this map the connection --

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Further on, the next route was the one established with one of the brigades of the Drina Corps that I cannot see on the map. To be more precise, with the Sokolac Brigade. The next route was established with the code-name Matica where the 2nd Romanija Brigade was. The next route was established because the Romanija Brigade did not have good communication with its subordinate units. Therefore, they established a link via RRU 1 with one of their battalions called Odra. This red flag on the right denotes the General Staff of the army of Republika Srpska, and this command had a wire connection. So this was not the connection via RRU 1, no. They had a wire connection with the command. The next line is with the code-name Zlatar, which was the command of the Drina Corps, and that was the radio relay route RRU 800 with the command of the army of Republika Srpska. This was their link --

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: With respect to --

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: -- with the Zlatar unit.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: -- to the connection that you'd indicated that the General Staff had that was by wire, could you indicate or write on the map maybe -- well, I guess you could write "wire" or W on that circle.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Marks].

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: He can complete it. He can write "wire," it will confuse us less later on.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Now, the staff that you indicated, there was the Main Staff of the VRS; is that right?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: With the relation to the location of Zlatar, can you tell us what that location was?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Zlatar, I can't see it here. That was the command of the Drina Corps, and it is marked here. Line number 19 links up the command of the Drina Corps with Veliki Zep. The next line, line number 20, linked up the Sekovici Brigade with the Drina Corps and then beyond. Line 21 is somewhere above Sekovici. There was a command there, and I can't tell you which one. I believe that the name of the locality was Osmaci. Line 22 linked up, in my estimate, the engineers regiment with the code-name Udarnik stationed at Konjevic Polje, I believe. And line 24 linked up Milici Brigade with its superior command.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Can you identify from these lines any line that goes up in the area of Zvornik or near there?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: The lines with Zvornik were established across Cer, Gucevo, and down to Zvornik. Since Zvornik was in a depression, there was no optical visibility, and that's why they used the so-called reflecting signal, which is the thick black line.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Okay. For this exhibit, could you write maybe in the top left-hand corner PW-131, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Okay. I was wondering if we could go to a different part of the map. I'd like to go to the part of the map -- let's see. It's still over to your right. A bit north, north of that. And a bit -- well, could you blow that up, please? Okay. Down. Yes. And where the -- right near where the end of that vector is on your left. Okay, a little bit down -- a little bit down from there. That seems fine. Okay. If you could blow it up a little bit, please. Okay. Right where it says Palma, could you blow that up, please. Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Can you see that, Mr. Witness?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: And do you see the destination Palma on there?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Perhaps we can blow that up just a little bit more.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Okay. Next to that word there is a line that runs north and south, I guess you could say, up and down. Could you tell us where that line goes running downwards?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: The line running from the north to the south leads to Veliki Zep, from Gucevo to Veliki Zep.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Do you see Gucevo on this particular exhibit?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: No. A bit to the north. Now you can see it.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: With the pen could you mark on this particular exhibit those two locations.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: This is Gucevo with the code-name Brana 99, and it was included in the documents, communications documents, of the army of Republika Srpska, although it is located in Serbia. This is the radio relay hub. Down there where there's the red flag, that stands for the Zvornik Brigade. We have a terminal radio relay station there as well, which meant that this is where the communications ended, and this is the area.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Is that in the area of Zvornik?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Could you just underline -- underline the city, the name of the city on the map.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: [Marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. And on where the line is -- where the word Palma is written, could you just indicate that that goes down to Veliki Zep. In other words, put a number next to it, maybe number 1 in this case, and write Veliki Zep.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Palma is not the name for Veliki Zep. Palma is the code-name of the Zvornik Brigade. That's why you have Zvornik-Palma. It has nothing to do with Veliki Zep. It's the other line that crosses the word Palma that goes to Veliki Zep.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: The vertical line you're referring to, right?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Right. Indicate next to that line that it goes to Veliki Zep.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: [Marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Okay. If you could just mark on the top left-hand side of this exhibit also PW-131, please.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: [Marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: In relation to this particular exhibit, you'd indicated on the triangle that you circled on the top the code-name Brana; is that right?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Yes. Brana 99.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: And on a prior exhibit you'd indicated another triangle to the east -- to the west of this location, which I believe you referred to -- or had been referred to as Brana. Is there such a code-name with respect to the area to the left of this, to the west of it?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Can you please refer me to the area you have in mind?

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Okay. I think I can -- I think I actually can.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: If you go to the left of the screen. At the base of the big triangle on the top. Just keep going up and to your left now. Left. Right where that angular line bends going down. Right there. The triangle on your left. Yeah. Could you blow that up, please.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Okay. I believe that that's what was referred to as Brana before. Is that in fact the case? Is that accurate, the name?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Based on what we know, yes. If we set up a temporary radio relay station, and if we have a code-name already, then you add a number to it in order to distinguish it for the other. That's normal procedure. This is the radio relay station at Ciganiste to the north of Doboj with the code-name Brana.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Thank you. And that's just distinguishable from Brana 99, right, as a separate location?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Can we go on the map to the other side, please. That would be, I guess, to the east and down. Okay. A little further down, please. Okay. And then to the right in the area of Bratunac. Do you see that? A little bit down so we can get also Srebrenica in the same frame. Could you please just blow up that area, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Okay. Can you see that, Mr. Witness?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Indicate with a line underneath the name Srebrenica that's depicted on the map, please.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: [Marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Do you see Bratunac on this map?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Okay. Can you indicate also by highlighting the line of communication that goes through Bratunac or to Bratunac.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: [Marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Is it possible to move the map a little bit down? No. It's fixed. Okay. It's okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Are those two lines of communication connected with Veliki Zep, the area that you indicated before?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: And are you familiar with any code-name that's associated with the area of Bratunac or Srebrenica?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: You can look on the left-hand side. It says 22nd of January a forward command post was established at Pribicevac, and it was then that we established the existence of this route which got the extension 311. It was linked up with the command of the Drina Corps at Vlasenica, which meant that from Vlasenica by dialling extension 311 they could get connected to the line at Pribicevac. I can even recall the person establishing the connection, Captain Jevdjevic, and he was boasting about the fact that the lines functioned perfectly. I believe that he was Captain Jevdzevic from the command the Drina Corps.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Are you familiar with the code-name Badem?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Yes. That was the code-name of the Bratunac Brigade.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Are you familiar with the code-name Palma?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: The code-name Palma stands for Zvornik Brigade.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Are you familiar with the code-name Zlatar?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Zlatar is the code-name of the Drina Corps.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: And you're familiar with the code-name Panorama you indicated, right?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: On this exhibit there's -- there's a line further down from the two lines that you've marked. Can you tell us what that line is and to what it's connected?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS PW-131
utterances.text: This line stands for the radio relay route number 1, which linked up the Skelani Brigade with the command of the Drina Corps.

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Could you just write your name on this one? We'll save it, and we'll wrap it up.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] [Marks].

utterances.speaker: MR. VANDERPUYE
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Witness.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: So that brings us to the end of today's sitting. We'll continue tomorrow morning at 9.00. In the meantime, Witness, you are not to allow anyone to contact you or you try to contact anyone in connection the matters that you are testifying about. Tomorrow we continue at 9.00. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 28th day of November, 2006, at 9.00 a.m.
